description: Block until the email inbox receives a message, then return new messages with extracted one-time codes and links (verification links first). Pass after (the last message ID seen) to wait for newer ones. Returns timedOut: true after timeoutSeconds (default 25, max 30); call again to keep waiting.

after.description: Optional message ID; only newer messages are returned.

token.description: Management or inspection token for anonymous resources. Omit for resources owned by your authenticated workspace.

name: wait_for_email
